transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I came in because I got scared by what I’ve been doing. After I eat too much, I’ve been going to the bathroom and making myself throw up so I won’t gain weight. It’s not just something that happened once anymore, and I think I need help.
How often have you been making yourself throw up after eating?

For the past several months, it’s been happening most weeks. I’ll have one of those eating spells in secret, and then I go make myself throw up afterward. I can’t really say it’s just occasional anymore.
How often do you have these eating spells where you eat too much?

It’s been most weeks, for the last several months. I’ll have one of those eating spells in secret, and then afterward I make myself sick. So… it’s not something I can honestly call occasional anymore.
Are you afraid of gaining weight?

Yes. I worry about it a lot. Even something like my skirt feeling tight before church, or seeing my side view in a store mirror, can ruin my whole day. I feel like everybody can tell I’ve let myself go.
Have you ever had one of these eating spells where you ate too much, but you didn't make yourself throw up afterward?
A few times, maybe, but what really scared me is that most times after I eat too much, I end up making myself throw up so I won’t gain weight. It’s not just some one-time mistake anymore.
How often do you have one of these eating spells where you eat too much but you don't make yourself throw up afterward?
I’m not really sure how often, honestly. It’s not the usual thing for me, so I haven’t kept track. Maybe it happens here and there, but I can’t give you a good number.
How often do you make yourself throw up after one of these eating spells where you eat too much?
Most weeks, I’d say. For the past several months, if I have one of those eating spells, I usually end up making myself throw up afterward. I can’t really call it just occasional anymore.
Do you make yourself throw up after every time you eat too much because you're afraid of gaining weight?

Not every single time, no. But when I do eat too much, a lot of the time I end up going to the bathroom and making myself throw up because I’m scared I’ll gain weight. That’s really what scared me into coming in—it’s not just a one-time mistake anymore.
Do you ever make yourself throw up after eating a normal amount of food because you're afraid of gaining weight?

I’m not really talking about normal meals so much. What scared me is when I eat too much, then I go to the bathroom and make myself throw up because I’m afraid I’ll gain weight. It’s happened enough now that it doesn’t feel like just a one-time mistake.
Do you ever make yourself throw up after eating a normal amount of food?

Not really after a normal amount, no. It’s more after I’ve eaten too much—then I get scared about gaining weight and I go make myself throw up. That’s the part that’s gotten past just a one-time mistake.
Do you ever make yourself throw up after eating normally, without having had one of those eating spells where you ate too much?

No, not really after eating normally. It’s when I feel like I’ve eaten too much that I panic about gaining weight and go make myself throw up in the bathroom. That’s what scared me—it’s happened more than just once.
Do you ever make yourself throw up after eating, if you hadn't eaten an amount that you considered too much?

No, not if I didn’t think I’d eaten too much. It’s really after those times when I feel like I overdid it that I get scared about gaining weight and go make myself throw up. That’s what made me realize it wasn’t just a one-time thing anymore.
Do you ever make yourself throw up after eating a normal meal?

No, not after a normal meal. It’s when I feel like I’ve eaten too much that I get scared about gaining weight, and then I go to the bathroom and make myself throw up. And it’s happened enough now that I know it’s not just a one-time mistake.
Do you ever use any methods other than making yourself throw up to try to prevent weight gain after eating too much?
No… I don’t think so. It’s really just the throwing up that I’ve done after I feel like I ate too much. I haven’t used other ways, at least not that I can think of.
Do you ever use laxatives or diuretics to try to prevent weight gain?

No, I haven’t used laxatives or diuretics. It’s been making myself throw up after I feel like I ate too much, because I’m scared I’ll gain weight. That’s the part that’s gotten past feeling like just a one-time mistake.
Do you ever exercise excessively to try to prevent weight gain after eating too much?
No, I wouldn’t say I exercise to make up for it. I mean, I move around at work and things like that, but I don’t go do a bunch of exercise after eating too much.
Do you ever exercise a lot to try to burn off calories after eating?
No, not really. I don’t go work out or exercise a lot after I eat to burn it off. I mean, I’m on my feet some for work, but that’s not something I’m doing on purpose because I ate.
Do you make yourself throw up every time you feel you've eaten too much because of your fear of gaining weight?

Not every single time, no. But when I feel like I’ve really eaten too much, I’ve been going to the bathroom and making myself throw up because I’m scared of gaining weight. That’s what scared me, that it’s not just one mistake anymore.
Do you ever make yourself throw up after eating a normal meal without feeling like you've eaten too much?

No, not after what I’d call a normal meal. It’s more when I feel like I’ve eaten too much. That’s when I’ve gone to the bathroom and made myself throw up because I’m afraid I’ll gain weight. It’s been happening more than just once, and that’s what scared me.
